These independently generated fixtures contain only synthetic NyaDB test values.

Generated with xlwt 1.3.0, pyarrow 26.0.0, and dbf 0.99.11. No Navicat or third-party artwork/data is embedded.
The XLS fixture uses BIFF8/CFB, the Parquet fixture uses externally encoded DECIMAL, DATE, UINT64 and BINARY logical types, and the DBF fixture uses VFP nullable fields with explicitly selected UTF-8.

`external-settings.xls` is generated independently with xlwt 1.3.0. Its first worksheet contains a decoy field; the second has a preamble followed by an explicit field-name row and two data rows, exercising worksheet choice and original source row ranges.
